title: `connectTo` names an outbound call's address only where `net.connect_to` names the host, and the address policy and the certificate's host check still apply
divergesFromPhp: `CURLOPT_RESOLVE` takes any host-to-address mapping a script writes; here the host must be granted, the address is judged by the same policy a resolved one is, and the certificate is still checked against the URL's host
